subject: ISA scale runs — cirrus reservation details
body: Ines — compute plan for the ISA scale runs. The small stuff (Tetrominoes/CLEVR configs) fits titan best-effort and is already running. The June push is the real ask: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-06-01 — 384 accelerators — and both the CLEVRTex sweep and the Waymo Open scale test are scheduled against that week. The plan packs the sweep (12 configs × 3 seeds) into the first half of the week and the Waymo run into the back half, with checkpoints to Corpus every 2 h. Asks: (1) confirm the pod slice is contiguous — the Waymo input pipeline saturates host RAM if we're scattered; (2) a heads-up contact for that week in case we need a topology change on short notice. Dmitri's end-of-June decision depends directly on these runs landing. — Ivo
